notes: 5.62.0 built the derived-field registry and, in the same breath, refused a streak by name: a screener row carries aggregates, and a streak needs the year-by-year ladder. That refusal was correct and it left a hole. The motivating example — epsGrowthStreak — was the field the refusal kept sending people away from, and it had nowhere to go. Now it does. epsGrowthStreak — consecutive fiscal years of diluted EPS growth, computed in screen-vocabulary.statementStats off the same eleven-year income panel epsCagr5y and epsCagr10y already fetch.
